purpose: Defines request-scoped evidence capabilities and when the UI runtime may attach user preferences, season catalog, daily ranking summaries, strategy Wiki, and deterministic calculation results to host CLI model requests.

provider_neutral_selected_context_contra.purpose: Give Codex, Kimi, or any future host CLI the same compact current-game facts without relying on provider memory, skills, plugins, or visual guessing.
provider_neutral_selected_context_contra.numeric_fact_authority: Missing HUD values remain missing before numeric coercion. Active-match economy.hp <= 0 is excluded from selected context unless explicit elimination or postgame evidence separately confirms the match ended.

hard_data_query_policy.activation: Only the explicit Cruise composer action may send all three identifiers. Visible text, a copied prefix, semantic intent, ordinary presets, and provider memory cannot activate this capability.
hard_data_query_policy.open_theorycraft_policy: When the user delegates lineup construction instead of naming a carry or tank, Runtime must derive a bounded semantic_seed, mechanically expand legal atomic core branches, calculate formation/cost/item/augment/transition evidence, and expose a candidate_frontier plus a deterministic fallback branch. The Host Agent owns semantic branch selection and comparison, while Runtime owns expansion, legality, source policy, and final validation; it must not ask for a preselected core.
hard_data_query_policy.multi_domain_policy: One user request may ask for lineup, transitions, equipment continuity, and augments together. Runtime composes those deterministic Core evaluators into one bounded decision_math_context and one Host-owned answer; it must not choose only the first matching domain.
hard_data_query_policy.provider_memory_boundary: The persistent provider session may have observed rankings in earlier ordinary turns. This policy guarantees that direct or derived ranking and Wiki evidence does not participate in this turn's retrieval, candidate generation, deterministic scoring, action selection, or current-turn payload; it does not falsely claim epistemic erasure of provider history.

missing_input_policy.delegated_open_target: A user request to choose or construct the target is not a missing critical identity. Use deterministic auto-selection and disclose that it is a Core-only theoretical proxy without ranking-strength authority.
missing_input_policy.otherwise: Use declared baseline defaults, complete the bounded calculation, and disclose every omitted or defaulted input.
missing_input_policy.season_mechanic_rule: Optional season-mechanic inputs are declared by the captured season descriptor and supplied only by current-match evidence or explicit confirmation. When an optional input is missing, use its descriptor-owned default and disclosure; Common Runtime must not name or infer a season-specific mechanic.

daily_core_theory_query_policy.activation: Only the explicit lobby 日常聊天 action may send this typed capability. Visible or copied text, semantic intent, ordinary presets, and provider memory cannot activate it.
daily_core_theory_query_policy.continuity: Use the same persistent lobby provider conversation. Follow-up messages remain normal daily-chat turns and may refer to the current theory task through native provider history; only an explicit second click exits the typed mode.

ordinary_core_evidence_policy.selection: Ordinary strategy questions use the same typed current-Core entity and deterministic evaluator path as the explicit no-big-data action. Compatible Master+ evidence may be attached separately when allowed, but absence of rankings cannot remove Core champion, trait, skill, item, augment, Common-rule, or transition evidence.
ordinary_core_evidence_policy.entity_detail: Specific champion, trait, item, or augment questions retrieve only bounded matching current-Core records, including champion traits, skill summary, star attributes, and typed effects. The static season catalog remains a navigation meta map and is never treated as the complete entity payload.
ordinary_core_evidence_policy.lineup_theorycraft: Open lineup questions return a semantic_seed, bounded candidate_frontier, atomic legal rosters, requested transition populations, and a deterministic fallback. The Host compares coherent branches using attached skills, traits, formation burden, costs, item/augment/condition evidence, and lifecycle before choosing the response. These results are theorycraft proxies, not Master+ strength claims.
ordinary_core_evidence_policy.host_obligation: When deterministic current-Core evidence is executable, the Host must use it and cannot claim that only names were available or that attached mappings and effects were missing.

strategy_evidence_kernel_policy.planning: Runtime performs bounded deterministic multi-route discovery and prefetch before dispatch. The Host Agent receives the semantic_seed and may refine its evidence plan or request additional snapshot-bound evidence inside the same logical provider turn; Runtime does not spend a separate model call only to plan.
strategy_evidence_kernel_policy.coverage: Every turn carries an immutable evidence snapshot identity, a multi-route EvidencePlan, and a facet-level coverage receipt. Missing or degraded critical evidence limits only the affected claim; forbidden evidence remains unavailable and cannot be widened by a tool call.
strategy_evidence_kernel_policy.provider_behavior: Expose jcc.query_knowledge and jcc.calculate as visible read-only dynamic tools when the provider supports registered custom tools. Providers without that capability receive a prefetch-complete packet under the same source policy and coverage contract.
strategy_evidence_kernel_policy.budget: Ordinary turns target zero to two tool calls. Complex multi-domain turns may use up to six total calls; three expansion cycles are an Agent-facing advisory rather than a false portable transport invariant. Ordinary current-turn ledgers target 1 MiB and fail closed above 2 MiB; fixed strategic ledgers target 4 MiB and fail closed above 8 MiB. The static capsule remains separately capped at 256 KiB, and unused capacity is not consumed proactively.

popular_recipe_query_policy.activation: Only the explicit Cruise action labelled 查热门阵容 may activate this capability. Visible or copied text, semantic intent, an ordinary preset, and provider memory cannot activate it.
popular_recipe_query_policy.output_policy: Return only matching current-version Tencent official popular templates and their captured roles, items, positions, transitions, lineup code, gameplay text, typed auxiliary units, and auditable unresolved supplementary references. Always disclose that this catalog has no national strength authority and does not participate in Cruise matching or scoring.
popular_recipe_query_policy.atomicity: A recipe remains one atomic source template. Auxiliary pet or summon rows remain typed auxiliary_units and never become catalog champions or consume champion population by default. A source-typed unresolved hero remains a population-occupying external_roster_unit instead of being silently dropped or falsely mapped. An unresolved augment or item reference degrades only that supplementary field and cannot discard an otherwise valid atomic roster.
popular_recipe_query_policy.match_snapshot_policy: Start Match captures one exact recipe generation identity. A refresh during the match affects only a later Match. Missing or incompatible identity reports unavailable and never falls back to another Core Profile or season.

ranking_scope_policy.missing_preferred_tier_policy: report master_plus unavailable and omit ranking evidence; never substitute platinum_to_diamond or all_tiers
